description:
Building Resilience by Managing Thoughts and Emotions

*Conducted by : *
Rotary Club of Neo (Youth Team - Rtn Mehek, Rtn Meera and Rtn Suresh)
Rotary Club of Neo - RTN Saraswathi Suresh
Supported by speaker RTN Nitin Shah - Psychologist from Rotary Club of Seacoast

Objective:
Build awareness about mental health, emotional wellbeing, stress, and the unique psychological demands of being an educator.

Brief Overview:
Teachers often focus on students' wellbeing while neglecting their own. This session helps the teachers understand what mental health really means, recognise early signs of stress and emotional overload, and identify factors that influence their wellbeing.

Key Outcome:
Teachers develop awareness of their own mental and emotional state and understand why self-care is not selfish but essential.
